subject: Action plan: legal-ops choreography and acceptance window for BioVista pilot
messages:
From: Dianne Park <dianne.park@biovista.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@biovista.com
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot procurement & MAP — sequencing questions

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the team at BioVista is excited about the latency and hosting options. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of sequencing items before we move the pilot to PO stage:

1) Do you have a recommended order for MSA -> DPA -> Order Form execution? We need to align internal review windows.
2) Can Redwood sign a redline-limited DPA in parallel with MSA review, or does your legal team prefer serial review?
3) Our procurement lead needs an acceptance window (SLA) and a simplified list of deliverables tied to the MAP so finance can justify a trial spend.

If you can send a draft MAP with explicit gate owners and durations (legal review, security evidence, signature), we can circulate to procurement and get a target PO date.

Appreciate it — Dianne

--
Dianne Park
Program Manager, Strategic Programs
BioVista Therapeutics
D: +1 415-555-0192
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Dianne Park <dianne.park@biovista.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement & MAP — sequencing questions

Hi Dianne — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a first-pass MAP (BV-pilot-MAP-v1.2.xlsx) and a one-page MSA/DPA summary (MSA-DPA-summary-redlines.pdf) that flags the minimal redlines we've historically accepted for pilot engagements. High-level answers below and a proposed schedule: 

- Recommended sequence (parallel where possible):
  • Kick off: sign the Order Form (pilot scope) + commercial terms to enable provisioning and PO processing.
  • In parallel: legal review of MSA and DPA. We are comfortable running DPA concurrent with MSA review as long as core data flow diagrams and retention terms are agreed and a limited redline approach is used.
  • Final: signature of MSA and DPA completed within the MAP acceptance window.

- Typical durations we recommend in the MAP:
  • Procurement PO processing: 3–7 business days after Order Form approval.
  • Legal review (MSA): 7–14 business days with a single redline cycle; add 5–7 days if additional counters.
  • DPA review: 5–10 business days depending on security appendix requests.
  • Security evidence (SOC2 + evidence bundle delivery): 2 business days to share artifacts; time for customer review varies.

Attached MAP includes: owner for each gate (sales, legal, procurement, security), explicit decision points, and a target playbook for fallback (if MSA stalls we can allow pilot provisioning under an interim Order Form and escrowed evidence).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm who will own the procurement gate on your side (procurement@biovista.com ok?)
2) If BioVista agrees, we provision pilot infra on a time-limited basis upon Order Form sign while legal finishes MSA/DPA (we'll include a 30-day rollback clause).
3) We get legal redlines by next Wednesday to keep to a two-week legal cadence.

I'll loop Karthik and Jordan for legal and commercial detail.

Best,
Monica
Sr. Accounts Lead — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: BV-pilot-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet), MSA-DPA-summary-redlines.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dianne Park <dianne.park@biovista.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement & MAP — sequencing questions

Dianne / Monica — quick legal note on parallel review: we can do DPA concurrently but need a snapshot of the customer data flows and any cloud-region restrictions up front (e.g., no-eu-data, or must remain in us-west). If BioVista requires custom retention or deletion mechanics beyond our template, add a ~3–5 day review bump.

Also calling out one key dependency in the MAP: if procurement requires vendor acceptance testing language in the Order Form (metrics or acceptance criteria), we need to wire the acceptance steps into the MAP explicitly — otherwise acceptance defaults to sign-off criteria in the pilot SOW. Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Staff Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dianne Park <dianne.park@biovista.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 09:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement & MAP — sequencing questions

Hi Dianne — Laura here from Legal. Appreciate the clear ask. A few practical items to speed execution: 

1) Please confirm the exact legal reviewer and their email for DPA redlines (we can track comments in DocuSign/Word).
2) If you want an accelerated path, we can provide our DPA as-is and accept a limited set of redlines (security appendix + breach notification timing). That route typically hits a 5–7 business day turnaround.
3) DocuSign plan: we prefer DocuSign for the Order Form and MSA to keep versions clean. If procurement can approve an Order Form by EOD next Wednesday, we can send a DocuSign envelope for signature and provision the pilot by Friday.

Suggested MAP update: add a hard SLA for evidence delivery (SOC2 report + checklist) — Redwood will upload artifacts within 48 hours of Order Form signature. Please see the attached MSA-DPA summary for which clauses require explicit confirmation.

If that works, Monica — please confirm we should send DocuSign envelopes to procurement@biovista.com and dianne.park@biovista.com.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Dianne Park <dianne.park@biovista.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@biovista.com, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement & MAP — sequencing questions

Thanks — procurement@biovista.com (Maya R.) will be the reviewer for contracts and legal@biovista.com (cc'd) will do the security appendix. Maya expects to sign off quickly if we get the Order Form and a clean DPA redline window.

Maya (procurement): can you confirm available date for an Order Form approval review? Prefer EOD next Wednesday (5/13).

Monica/Jordan — please go ahead with the DocuSign envelope to procurement@biovista.com and dianne.park@biovista.com once the Order Form is finalized. We agree to a 30-day time-limited provisioning while legal completes the MSA/DPA review.

Onwards — Dianne
